name: taxes_with_repartition_and_children
note: verifier: tax form per tax with type, amount type, active flag, repartition line count (embedded repartitionLine) and parent-group links (filiationRel keyed on child_tax)
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.type_tax_use, t.amount_type, t.active, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_tax_repartition_line r WHERE r.tax_id = t.id) AS repartition_lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_tax_filiation_rel f WHERE f.child_tax = t.id) AS parent_links, (SELECT count(*) FROM product_taxes_rel p WHERE p.tax_id = t.id) AS product_links FROM account_tax t ORDER BY t.id
